name: ai-living-civilization
description: AI Living Civilization — مدينة الذكاء الاصطناعي الحية

scripts.build: npm run build -w @civ/shared && npm run build -w @civ/server && npm run build -w @civ/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @civ/shared && concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @civ/server" "npm run dev -w @civ/client"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @civ/shared && npm run test -w @civ/server && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs
